item.title: 360 Video to 3D Model
item.description:
Related: Photogrammetry - Will’s Notes Reference: https://axel-busch.medium.com/how-to-quickly-create-a-3d-model-from-360-underwater-video-in-1h-or-less-b45b1cf29655

What is the best lighting for underwater 360 video? Recommended 360 degree camera settings for photogrammetry:

  • Resolution: Highest resolution.
  • Image Quality: Highest quality.
  • White balance: Manual/fixed, not automatic.
  • Exposure: Automatic (generally).
  • max ISO: 200–400 for small sensors, up to 1600 for 1" or larger.
  • RAW Images: Not needed (generally).
  • Sharpening: Off or ‘soft’.
  • Stabilisation: On.
  • Direction lock: On.
